subject: Money
title: What Are Altcoins
description: Learn What Are Altcoins in one minute.

hook.text: There are over 26,000 cryptocurrencies. Bitcoin is the first. Everything else is an altcoin. Most will go to zero.

buildup.text: Altcoin means 'alternative coin.' Each claims to solve Bitcoin's limits: speed, privacy, smart contracts, or cost.

discovery.text: Top altcoins: Ethereum (smart contracts), Solana (speed), Cardano (research-first). Each has a unique approach.

twist.text: 95% of altcoins from 2017 are now worthless. The survival rate is worse than restaurants. Most are bad ideas or scams.

climax.text: A few altcoins may survive and thrive. Identifying them early is nearly impossible. Even experts get it wrong.

quiz.question: What percentage of altcoins from 2017 are now worthless?
